summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in react-native-drago-callkit@1.0.1
details: No install-time or import-time behavior consistent with credential exfiltration, remote code fetch-and-execute, silent relay, backdoor, or self-propagation was observed in this package version. No hardcoded attacker endpoints, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no environment scraping, and no lifecycle-hook or top-level network/exec primitives were identified across the 267 files inspected.
